01

“and He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever…”

An explanation transmitted from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr (Q 45:13).

889
Explanation from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr No. 889: 1: 16

ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr

English
Transmission wording
889: 1:16. Sufyan, from Abd Allah ibn Amr, on His words
"and He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, all from Him": He said, creation is from five: fire, light, darkness, water, and dust (verse 13).
العربية
889: 1: 16 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عمرو فِي قَوْلِهِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا في السماوات وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِنْهُ قَالَ الْخَلْقُ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ مِنْ نَارٍ وَنُورٍ وَظُلْمَةٍ وَمَاءٍ وَتُرَابٍ (الآية 13) .

02

“Have you seen the one who takes his own desire as his god, and God…”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 45:23).

890
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 890: 2: 1

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
890: 2:1. Sufyan, from Jafar, from Said ibn Jubayr:
"Have you seen the one who takes his own desire as his god, and God has led him astray knowingly?": He said, they used to worship a stone, and when they saw a stone better than it, they would throw it away and take the other (verse 23).
العربية
890: 2: 1 سفيان عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عِلْمٍ قَالَ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ الْحَجَرَ فَإِذَا رَأَوْا حَجَرًا أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ أَلْقَوْهُ وأخذوا الآخر (الآية 23) .
